title: SIU probes police shooting in Lindsay that killed Scarborough man
article: The province's Special Investigations Unit continues to probe a shooting in Lindsay that took the life of a Scarborough man and injured a police officer.
The SIU identified the dead man as 21-year-old Corey Aaron Armstrong, a resident of a Morningside Avenue apartment building.
The gunfire occurred during the execution of a warrant at a home on Georgian Street in Lindsay on June 22.
Peterborough Lakefield Police Service Const. Keith Calderwood was shot and wounded. At least one of the officer's injuries was caused by a police firearm, the SIU said.
The civilian agency investigates whenever there is a serious injury or death involving police.
